messages:
sara-peopleops: Morning — quick heads up: we're rolling out two short updates today: 1) Benefits opt-in tweaks for 2026 (clarifies transfer/waiver rules), 2) Mandatory "Data & Confidentiality" refresher for all active staff. Please review and ACK by 2026-12-01. Summary + diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/changes/1767804001

meera-hr: Quick Q — do remote contractors need to take the refresher or just employees?

tom-payroll: Payroll note: dependent-care pre-tax deduction window updated. If you want deductions to start Jan, enroll by 2026-12-05. Send edge cases to payroll@redwood.

alec-recruiting: Heads up — we have 4 new hires with start dates Dec 10–15. Will they get the training auto-assigned?

onboarding-bot: Auto-assignment rule: new hires with start_date <= 2026-12-31 will be enrolled and get the welcome packet + course link: https://training.redwood/assign/data-conf-2026.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Course assigned — "Data & Confidentiality 2026". Due 2026-12-08. Weekly nudges will go to managers. Completion report to be emailed on 2026-12-09.

leah.peopleops: Managers: please add a 5-min ACK item to your team meeting this week. I'll pull the ACK list on 2026-12-02 and follow up with any teams under 90% completion.

meera-hr: Contractors who touch PII must complete the refresher and sign the contractor NDA addendum. Non-PII contractors are exempt. Please update the contractor tracker with access level.

alec-recruiting: Added the 4 new hires to onboarding so they'll get assigned. Thanks for clarifying, @meera-hr.

sara-peopleops: Office hours Tues 9:00am PT to walk through changes and the enrollment flow. If you want slides, ping me and I'll post in #people-ops-resources. :calendar:
